sys_app.name: TestReach
sys_app.description: ATF Coverage Analyzer and Test Gap Detector. Maps ATF tests to artifacts (business rules, script includes, client scripts, flows, UI actions) to surface coverage gaps, upgrade risk, and auto-generated test skeletons.
sys_app.license_agreement: Free distribution under MIT license. No warranty. Use at own risk.

sys_app_license.name: TestReach Community License
sys_app_license.description: TestReach free community edition. Coverage analyzer for ServiceNow ATF.

sys_script_include.name: TestReachCoverageEngine
sys_script_include.description: Static coverage analyzer. Builds the dependency graph from ATF tests and computes per-artifact coverage.

sys_script_include.name: TestReachRiskEngine
sys_script_include.description: Risk scoring, upgrade gap analysis, ATF test skeleton generation, GenAI integration, and REST dispatch. Single integration point for POST /execute.
